The '''''Jannimak''''' was a technologically advanced [[research vessel]] that [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Crash Site Outpost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Crash Site Outpost}}</ref> at some point around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The research vessel used for a project to study and acclimatize different lifeforms from many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including [[Species/Legends|creatures]], [[Plant/Legends|plants]], and microorganisms. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Rotkar]], the vessel's creator, was proud of the success of the project.<ref name="Jannimak" />

After the mysterious crash of the vessel, a large area of unoccupied farmland on Dantooine became overrun with invasive species. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s systems designed to accommodate the creatures and plant life aboard began rapidly changing the planet's surface to create suitable habitats. Researchers from various backgrounds set up an outpost near the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]] to study the vessel and uncover its unknown origins.<ref name="Crash Site Outpost" />

[[File:SWTOR Dantooine Crash Site.png|thumb|right|250px|The crash site of the ''Jannimak''.]]
==Behind the scenes==
The ''Jannimak'' first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
